title: Ops Lattice: Reserve Inspector microflow for GPU pool health & burst policies
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Design a compact, operator-focused Reserve Inspector microflow that surfaces per-GPU-pool health, short-term predictive surge forecasts, and a safe UX for burst/override actions. This ticket covers low-fidelity -> mid-fidelity prototype, PM/Eng design review, and handoff assets for engineering. Scope: pool summary card, health sparkline + occupancy histogram, active SLO badges, top anomalous routes, quick burst action (preview + confirm), autoscale hysteresis controls, and per-route cost delta preview. Constraints: must fit into existing Console sidepanel pattern, respect tokenized design system spacing, and support rapid A/B tests for different burst confirmation flows. Non-goal: full-page fleet management, long-form runbook editor (will be separate).
acceptance_criteria: Interactive mid-fidelity prototype demonstrates a sidepanel microflow that opens from pool row and shows health summary + controls
Design includes two burst/override flows: immediate override (with live cost delta preview) and scheduled window (start/end) with hysteresis params
UX patterns follow Console accessibility standards (keyboard focus, color contrast) and pass basic accessibility checklist
Handoff artifacts include annotated Figma frames, tokens list, CSS spacing hints, and a short interaction spec for engineers
PM and Eng have signed off on trade-offs for telemetry density vs. cognitive load (review comments captured)

decisions: Use a single compact sidepanel (not a full page) to keep operator context when jumping between pools
Expose a "Saturation" composite metric instead of raw GPU util% in the top summary badge
Two-step confirmation for immediate bursts: preview -> confirm with cost delta and SLA impact tooltip
Autoscale controls default to conservative hysteresis for multi-tenant Dedicated clusters; enterprise customers can unlock advanced sliders via a modal
tradeoffs: Telemetry density vs. cognitive load: opted to show 3 sparklines (latency, saturation, error rate) + occupancy histogram rather than full metric table
Quick actions vs. safe defaults: enabling immediate burst is a shorter path but requires stronger confirmation to avoid accidental spend
Predictive preview accuracy vs. speed: preview uses a 5-minute sampled model to keep UI responsive; a background job will recompute higher-fidelity forecasts for audit logs
review_feedback: PM (Priya): Add per-route cost delta when burst is scoped to routes, not whole pool
Eng (Marco): Need an API contract change to return 'saturation' percentile; created ENG-72111
Security: Ensure every burst action writes an audit entry and supports role-based restriction (RBAC) — include flag 'requires-approval' for enterprise scopes
